caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: “How to Create Your Infographic AESTHETIC” foregrounds the key term as a lavender rough-display tag.
visual_anatomy.layout: A horizontal spectrum/slider selects among visual directions; one large nested-circle sample occupies the lower two thirds of the page.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → spectrum position → selected option’s compact attributes → large visual example.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large headline, hand-rendered key word, compact labels for canvas/colour/pros/cons, and minimal instructional text.
visual_anatomy.colour: The full canvas, accent tag, spectrum position, and nested-circle sample shift together between visual directions.
visual_anatomy.surface: Clean field with fine rules, rounded option labels, shallow shadow, and a large flat/concentric illustration sample.
visual_anatomy.modules: One selection spectrum, a four-field option descriptor, and one large style example.
visual_anatomy.density: Low-to-medium: it privileges comparison across states rather than a dense final board.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled frames move the spectrum selector across named aesthetics while the whole page changes background, color treatment, and lower-circle rendering.
motion.motion_job: Demonstrate stateful variation: a reader sees which parts of a system change together when a single choice changes.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare alternative treatments of one underlying concept without mistaking them for different concepts.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: State selector with a consistent specimen.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Keep the information structure fixed while a selector changes one coherent set of presentation variables.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use motion only when the comparison between states is the point; present the selected end state as a readable still.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the aesthetic taxonomy, spectrum layout, nested-circle specimen, tag treatment, option labels, color states, or source animation.

claim_boundary.note: The visual is a design-choice explanation. Its claims about style are source material, not a validated decision rule for Shetty’s Desk.
